# Cam Leinad

> Cam Leinad is the artist name of Muwonge Daniel Mark, born in Uganda and raised across countries including the United Kingdom and South Korea. Cam Leinad is the reverse of Daniel Mac — literally and musically. His heartfelt pop blends easy-listening warmth with timeless pop craft. His catalog is fully released and includes the single "How It Starts," the six-track EP "Distant Light," and the 13-track debut album "The Confession" (November 2026), released independently on Cam All May.

## Artist
